Date December 6, 19 38.

Subject (in full) PRICE, S.R. - arrival in Shanghai.

Made by D.S. Hocking Forwarded by Inspector E. Pay.

Mr. Stewart R. PRICE, American, concerned
for many years with gambling operations in Shanghai and a
former associate and suspected partner of Garcia, arrived
here aboard the R.M.S. "Empress of Canada" on 29-11-38. He
booked his passage in New York and embarked at Vancouver, as
a British subject. His local address at present is Room 700,
Cathay Hotel.

With reference to the endorsements appearing
on the attached report relating to the affairs of S.R.Price,
American, I have to state that lengthy enquiries have
failed to establish anything of an absolute concrete
nature in connection with the gambling activities of this
individual. He has, however, been heard to remark in
certain quarters recently that during the Chinese New Year
he intends to give several big 'parties' during the course
of which he expects to "make big money." The location
of these parties has not yet been discovered, but should
anything be ascertained in this connection, a further
report will be immediately submitted.

Information was recently received to the effect
that Stewart R. PRICE, American, well-known gambling organiser
in Shanghai, was acting as the Shanghai representative of
Garcia of "wheel" fame. It is reported that Garcia is at
present in Japan and wishes to return to Shanghai, but is
rather afraid that should he attempt to enter via this port
by steamer he will receive the same treatment that was meted
out to Paul Crawley, who upon his return from the United
States was detained by the Chinese Authorities and later deported.

Price, who resides at Apartment No. 737 Cathay
Hotel, is known to be the silent head of a gambling syndicate
operating locally, and no attempts are made to disguise the
fact that he is connected with gamblers, among the staff of the
Cathay Hotel. Price has been residing on and off at this
hotel for about two years and a half and periodically makes
trips on business to America, Japan, the Philippines and Macao.

He receives practically no visitors at the Cathay
but he is known to leave the premises very frequently at night
time for addresses in the Western district. When he does this
he is in the habit of employing Ford Hire Service cars.

He has no legitimate business locally but is
known to be well furnished with money.

最近收到消息，称在上海知名的赌博组织者、美国人斯图尔特·R·普赖斯 (Stewart R. PRICE)，正担任以“轮盘赌”闻名的加西亚 (Garcia) 的上海代表。据报道，加西亚目前在日本，希望返回上海，但相当担心如果他试图乘轮船经此港口入境，将会受到与保罗·克劳利 (Paul Crawley) 相同的待遇；克劳利从美国返回时被中国当局拘留，随后被驱逐出境。

普赖斯居住在华懋饭店 (Cathay Hotel) 737号公寓，众所周知他是当地一个赌博辛迪加的幕后头目，且毫不掩饰他与华懋饭店员工中的赌徒有联系。普赖斯断断续续在该酒店居住了约两年半，并定期因公务前往美国、日本、菲律宾和澳门。

他在华懋饭店几乎不接待访客，但众所周知他经常在夜间离开住处，前往西区的一些地址。当他这样做时，习惯雇用福特租车服务 (Ford Hire Service) 的车辆。

他在本地没有正当职业，但众所周知他资金充裕。

Date July 14 1933

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
Narcotic Section C.1.
CONFIDENTIAL REPORT

Subject (in full) Stewart Price

Made by D.I. Papp Forwarded by Supt. Hunter

（左侧边注：See also O/231. attached）

With reference to the attached note from D.C. (Crime)
I respectfully beg to report that according to information received
Mr. Stewart Price is at present at Washington, where he is lobbying
with a view to securing the removal from the U.S. Court for China
of judge M.D. Purdy, the present judge, and to transferring in his
place of judge Lobinger, a former judge of the U.S. Court for
China.

In connection with the above information enquiries have
been made at the local Consulate-General for U.S.A. and it has been
learned that the aforesaid Consulate was aware of the fact that
S. Price is at present in Washington. As regards the rumour that
S. Price had financed the Ezras in their activities nothing definite
can be gleaned.

Forwarded
J.H. 14/7/33
D.C. (Crime)

E. Papp
D.I.

（印：DEPUTY COMMISSIONER CRIME BRANCH 14 JUL 1933）

机密报告

事由（全称）斯图尔特·普赖斯

撰写人：督察帕普 (D.I. Papp) 转呈人：巡官亨特 (Supt. Hunter)

（左侧边注：另见附上的 O/231。）

关于犯罪科副警务处长附上的便笺，本人谨报告如下：根据收到的消息，斯图尔特·普赖斯先生目前在华盛顿，正在进行游说，旨在促使撤换现任美国驻华法院法官 M.D. 珀迪 (M.D. Purdy)，并由前美国驻华法院法官洛宾格 (Lobinger) 接替其职位。

就上述消息而言，已向美国驻上海总领事馆进行调查，获悉该总领事馆已知悉 S. 普赖斯目前在华盛顿这一事实。至于有关 S. 普赖斯为以斯拉家族 (Ezras) 的活动提供资金的传闻，未能收集到任何确切信息。

转呈
J.H. 1933年7月14日
副警务处长（犯罪科）

E. 帕普
督察

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No. __________
Special Branch S. 4. Station,
REPORT
Date March 20. 19 33

Subject (in full) Alleged proposed visit to Paris of Stewart Price
on behalf of Doo Yueh Sung.

Made by __________ and __________ Forwarded by D.S.I. MOORE.

With reference to the attached memorandums regarding
a proposed visit to Paris of Stewart Price on behalf of Doo
Yueh Sung, I have to report that enquiries show the informa-
tion to be groundless.
Price is at present staying at the Cathay Hotel and
has not signified any intention of leaving, and enquiries at
shipping offices and travel agencies show no reservation in
his name, provisional or otherwise.

D. S. I.
Officer i/c Special Branch.

S4, Please ascertain discreetly the
description of Stewart Price.
JMG

关于附呈备忘录中提及的斯图尔特·普赖斯代表杜月笙拟访问巴黎一事，本人须报告称，调查显示该消息毫无根据。
普赖斯目前住在华懋饭店，并未表示有任何离境意向，且在轮船公司和旅行社的调查也显示没有以他的名义进行任何预订，无论是临时预订还是其他形式。
